name: vb-brand-systems
description: Plug-and-play brand system template for Next.js: guidelines, downloadable assets and an AI assistant that knows your brand. English and Portuguese, guided by an agent skill. Demo needs no setup.

paragraphs: A brand system is the single place where everything about a brand lives: what it believes, how it speaks, how it looks, and the files you need to use it. VB Brand Systems is that place, as an app you run on your own computer, in English and Portuguese, and make yours by editing a few files.
It is also built for something a PDF manual or a shared folder cannot do: give an AI the full context of your brand, so it answers and helps you decide with your rules in mind instead of guessing.
Content: your guidelines, as pages. A navigable manual written in plain MDX files. The sample brand organizes it from the most abstract to the most concrete:
features: Brand Core: purpose, mission, values and positioning.
Verbal Universe: personality, voice principles and writing examples.
Visual Universe: logo and its misuse, color palette with copy-to-clipboard swatches and tokens, color usage and contrast, type families and type scale.
Applications: how it all comes together in real pieces, such as social media.
A Sonic Universe section, marked "coming soon", for you to fill.

requirements.text: Login, a role for each member (admin or staff), your profile and password, light and dark themes, and English or Portuguese.
Demo mode (default): no accounts, no database, no keys.
Full mode: login, members, asset uploads, chat history and the AI assistant, once you connect Supabase and one AI provider key.
